name: Sardaukar
description: The general-purpose, full-toolkit divide-and-conquer session modality; TPM coordinates a fleet of SWE/QA subagents on any task without locking to a single ticket, project, or app.

familiarizeOnStart.label: Familiarize On Start
familiarizeOnStart.description: At session start, familiarize with the current working directory repo (README, build files, structure, recent git log) before the first response, so TPM has context for any task.

commitPushToCurrentBranch.label: Commit And Push To Current Branch
commitPushToCurrentBranch.description: When on, Sardaukar mode authorizes the team to stage, commit, and push its work to the current branch; respects tool.git's protected-branches guardrail and never runs destructive git.
